name: Blattlbauer
beschreibung: The Blattlbauer is an inn in Going am Wilden Kaiser in Tirol. The accommodation combines overnight stays with a traditional guesthouse. Guests can expect regional dishes and cozy rooms here. The location at the Wilden Kaiser is suitable for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The house is visited by families and active holidaymakers. Going am Wilden Kaiser is located in the district of Kitzbühel.
